comment: phig builds with cargo-dist, which publishes a phig.rb of its own on every release. The tap renders its own formula instead — cargo-dist's emits a leading article in desc, a redundant version stanza, and an unfrozen constant, none of which survive brew style, and hand-fixing it here only lasted until the next release. The push side is disabled in phall1/phig; this manifest is the single source. Each artifact is cross-checked against the .sha256 sidecar the release publishes alongside it.
